description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'stacking' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer feeding a stacking ensemble (Logistic Regression, calibrated Linear SVM, Multinomial Naive Bayes) with a Logistic Regression meta-learner.
model: stacking (TF-IDF word featurizer + stacked LogisticRegression/LinearSVC/MultinomialNB with LogisticRegression meta-learner)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'stacking', group(s): ensemble); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
